methods.name: Cash on Delivery
methods.description: Pay cash when your order is delivered.
methods.instructions: Pay cash to our courier delivery rider upon arrival of your parcel. Please keep the exact amount ready to avoid delays.

methods.name: Credit / Debit Card
methods.description: Pay securely with Visa, Mastercard, or PayPak.
methods.instructions: Online card payments are processed via 3D Secure 2.0 banking gateways. Card processing is currently undergoing banking PCI-DSS certification — please choose Cash on Delivery, Easypaisa, or JazzCash for immediate order dispatch.
methods.warningMessage: Direct credit/debit card processing is currently undergoing banking PCI-DSS integration with State Bank of Pakistan compliant gateways. To place your order immediately, please select Cash on Delivery, Easypaisa, or JazzCash.

methods.name: Easypaisa
methods.description: Instant transfer via Easypaisa Mobile App or *786#.
methods.instructions:
1. Open your Easypaisa app or dial *786#.
2. Transfer the exact order amount to our official merchant account.
3. Enter your Order ID in the transfer remarks/reference.
4. Enter the 11-digit Transaction ID (TID) received via SMS below for verification.
methods.accountHelpText: 💡 Please include your customer contact number or upcoming Order ID in the payment message so our accounts team can verify immediately.
methods.referenceHelpText: After sending payment from your mobile wallet, paste the reference ID from your SMS above.
methods.referenceValidationMessage: Please enter a valid 11-digit Easypaisa Transaction ID (TID).

methods.name: JazzCash
methods.description: Instant transfer via JazzCash Mobile App or *786#.
methods.instructions:
1. Open your JazzCash app or dial *786#.
2. Transfer the exact order amount to our official JazzCash account.
3. Mention your Order ID in the reference field.
4. Enter the Transaction ID (TID) received from 8558 below for verification.
methods.accountHelpText: 💡 Please include your customer contact number or upcoming Order ID in the payment message so our accounts team can verify immediately.
methods.referenceHelpText: After sending payment from your mobile wallet, paste the reference ID from your SMS above.
methods.referenceValidationMessage: Please enter a valid 12-digit JazzCash Transaction ID (TID).

security.generalInstructions: Select your preferred payment method below. All transactions are monitored and encrypted.
security.securityNotice: Only make payments using the official payment details shown on this website. We will never ask you to send money to a personal account or share your password, OTP, PIN, CVV or full card details.
security.processingMessage: Orders paid via Easypaisa or JazzCash are placed on hold ("Awaiting Verification") until our accounts department confirms receipt of the Transaction ID.

customInfoBlocks.title: Discreet & Secure Parcel Handling
customInfoBlocks.content: Every package is sealed with tamper-evident tape and tracked throughout courier transit across Pakistan.
